# Luma PDF

A universal PDF workspace that runs entirely in the browser: read, search, annotate, edit, convert, and embed PDFs without uploading anything.

**v1.5.1** · static files · no build step · no backend · no account

---

## Performance notes

* Every page carries its CSS inline (generated by `node scripts/inline-critical.mjs`), so
  the first paint never waits on stylesheet round trips. Re-run that script after editing
  `css/`.
* The homepage renders its eight tool tiles from a short static list — it does not download
  the tool catalogue or pdf.js.

* The first page paints from a low-resolution preview, then sharpens — you never wait for
  a full-quality render to start reading.
* pdf-lib (525 KB) is only loaded when you edit, fill a form or export; viewing never pays
  for it.
* Page geometry, thumbnails, the outline and form detection are all deferred until after
  the first page.
* While scrolling fast, only the page under the reader is rendered, at reduced resolution;
  the sharp pass follows when you stop.
* Phones render at a capped pixel budget (1.5× DPR, 3 MP/page), which is invisible on a
  small screen and roughly halves the work per page.
* Pages far from the viewport are unmounted, so a 400-page document keeps ~38 page nodes
  instead of 400.
* Rendering always yields to input: queued renders are dropped when you tap or scroll, and
  a new render waits for the interaction to paint.
* Open `performance` marks in DevTools (`luma:module`, `luma:pdf-parsed`,
  `luma:first-page`) to see exactly where time goes on your own device.

## What it does

| Surface | File | What you get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Viewer | `viewer.html` | Continuous / single / horizontal / spread / book layouts, RTL, presentation and distraction-free modes, 25–500% zoom with pinch and cursor-anchored wheel zoom, drag-to-pan, whole-document search over the real text layer, thumbnails, outline, bookmarks, annotations that snap to text, **fillable form fields**, a **signature library** (draw / type / upload) and export into a new PDF |
| Tools | `tools.html` | 39 utilities: merge, split, extract, delete, reorder, rotate, crop, **auto-crop**, resize, duplicate, **N-up / booklet**, PDF↔JPG/PNG/WebP, images→PDF, PDF↔text, **PDF→Markdown**, **OCR**, print images, compress, optimise, reduce, strip metadata, metadata, page count, file info, dimensions, version, password check, **protect/unlock (AES-256)**, outline, text extraction, screenshot, watermark, page numbers, signature, **form fields**: merge, split, extract, delete, reorder, rotate, crop, resize, duplicate, PDF↔JPG/PNG/WebP, images→PDF, PDF↔text, print images, compress, optimise, reduce, strip metadata, metadata, page count, file info, dimensions, version, password check, outline, text extraction, screenshot, watermark, page numbers, signature |
| Editor | `editor.html` | Page organiser (multi-select, drag reorder, rotate, duplicate, delete, extract, **insert blank pages**, **undo/redo**) plus export-time text, image, watermark and page-number overlays |
| Embed | `embed.html` | Chrome-light viewer configured by 26 URL parameters, with a `postMessage` API and strict origin checks |
| Generator | `embed-generator.html` | Live preview, presets, generated URL and iframe snippets |
| Library | `library.html` | Local-only document library with reading positions, favourites and storage controls |
| Docs | `docs.html` | Embedding, API, deployment, CORS, security, performance, testing |

Everything is a real implementation: no placeholder buttons, and features that cannot work in a browser say so plainly.

## Quick start

```bash
# any static server works
python3 -m http.server 8080
# then open http://localhost:8080/
```

Open a PDF with the drop zone, or go straight to a file:

```
viewer.html?file=/docs/report.pdf
viewer.html?doc=<library-id>
embed.html?file=https://example.com/report.pdf&theme=dark&page=3
```

Deploy by copying the folder to Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel, GitHub Pages, Firebase Hosting, Apache, Nginx or any static host. See [`docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).

## Technology

* **HTML5 / CSS3 / vanilla ES modules** — no framework, no runtime.
* **[PDF.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/) 3.11.174** (Apache-2.0) — rendering, text layer, search, outline, metadata.
* **[pdf-lib](https://pdf-lib.js.org/) 1.17.1** (MIT) — page copying, rotation, watermarks, annotation export, AcroForm filling.
* **[qpdf](https://qpdf.readthedocs.io/) (WASM)** (Apache-2.0) — AES-256 password protection and unlocking, vendored in `vendor/qpdf/`.
* **[Tesseract.js](https://tesseract.projectnaptha.com/) 5.1.1** (Apache-2.0) — OCR; the engine is fetched on first use (see `docs/OCR.md`).
* **IndexedDB** — local documents, annotations, bookmarks, reading positions.
* **Service worker + manifest** — installable PWA with an offline shell.

Both libraries are vendored in `vendor/`, pinned, and loaded from the same origin: the app works offline and never calls a CDN.

## Project structure

```
luma-pdf/
├── index.html                 homepage
├── viewer.html                reader + annotations
├── tools.html                 39 PDF tools
├── editor.html                page organiser + overlays
├── embed.html                 embeddable viewer
├── embed-generator.html       embed builder
├── docs.html                  developer documentation
├── library.html               local library
├── settings.html              preferences
├── about.html                 privacy + licences
├── offline.html               service-worker fallback
├── manifest.json  sw.js  favicon.svg
├── assets/                    icons, images, fonts
├── css/                       tokens, reset, themes, main, layout, homepage,
│                              viewer, toolbar, sidebar, annotations, editor,
│                              tools, embed, animations, responsive
├── js/
│   ├── app.js  shell.js  config.js  state.js  theme.js
│   ├── pages/                 one module per page
│   ├── viewer/                pdf-engine, renderer, viewer, search,
│   │                          thumbnails, annotations, toolbar, keyboard,
│   │                          navigation, forms, signatures
│   ├── editor/                document-editor, page-editor, export,
│   │                          text-editor, image-editor
│   ├── tools/                 catalog, pdf-utils, merge, split, convert,
│   │                          compress, metadata, watermark, security,
│   │                          ocr, markdown, impose
│   ├── embed/                 config, messaging, api
│   ├── storage/               database, library, history, cache
│   ├── pwa/                   install, updates
│   ├── performance/           device-detection, adaptive-rendering, memory-manager
│   ├── ui/                    icons, ui primitives
│   └── utils/                 dom, files, urls, security, browser, accessibility, zip
├── vendor/                    pdfjs/, pdf-lib/, qpdf/ (pinned)
├── docs/                      README, EMBEDDING, API, DEPLOYMENT, SECURITY, CORS, PERFORMANCE, TESTING, OCR
└── deployment/                netlify.toml, vercel.json, _headers, apache.conf, nginx.conf
```

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `←` `→` `↑` `↓`, `PageUp`/`PageDown` | Navigate pages |
| `Space` + drag, or middle-drag | Pan the page |
| `Ctrl/Cmd` + wheel, pinch | Zoom around the pointer |
| Double-click | Zoom in / back to fit width |
| `Home` / `End` | First / last page |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + F` | Search |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + P` | Print |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + S` | Save / download |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + +` / `-` | Zoom in / out |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + 0` | Fit width |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + B` | Toggle sidebar |
| `F` | Fullscreen |
| `R` | Rotate view |
| `Z` | Distraction-free mode |
| `H` | Hand tool |
| `V` `S` `U` `K` `P` `M` `E` `T` `N` `B` `O` `A` `L` `G` `I` | Annotation tools (select, highlight, underline, strike, pen, marker, eraser, text, note, box, ellipse, arrow, line, image, signature) |
| `Ctrl/Cmd + D` / `Del` | Duplicate / delete the selected annotation |
| `Escape` | Close dialogs, search or fullscreen |

Shortcuts are ignored while typing in a field and can be disabled in Settings.

## Privacy

* No uploads: files are decoded in memory by PDF.js.
* No accounts, no analytics, no telemetry, no third-party requests.
* Saved documents live in this browser's IndexedDB and can be deleted from the Library or Settings.
* PDFs never execute their embedded JavaScript (`isEvalSupported: false`).
* Remote PDFs are fetched directly from their host — Luma PDF ships no CORS proxy.

## Known limitations

* Encrypted PDFs can be read with a password, but the editing tools refuse them.
* Re-saving a signed PDF invalidates its signature.
* Compression re-renders pages as images, so text stops being selectable.
* OCR is not bundled; scanned pages without a text layer are reported honestly.
* Very large documents are bounded by browser memory, not by the app.
* Signature placement draws an image — it is not a cryptographic signature.
